core_obligations: (1): separatedness of the morphism means its diagonal is proper over the source, and a proper morphism of algebraic spaces is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, which is quasi-separatedness of the morphism (proof lines 691-694)
(2): DM-ness means the diagonal is unramified, and an unramified morphism of algebraic spaces is locally quasi-finite, which is quasi-DM-ness (proof lines 695-697)
(3): representability by algebraic spaces gives that the diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces, which is DM-ness by the corresponding characterization (proof lines 698-699)
proof_roadmap: (1)：分离 ⇒ Δ 是 proper ⇒ 准紧且准分离 ⇒ 准分离。
(2)：DM ⇒ Δ unramified ⇒ 局部拟有限 ⇒ 准 DM。
(3)：可表示 ⇒ Δ 可表示 ⇒ DM（本章对 Δ 的刻画引理）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows three implications for a morphism of algebraic stacks: separated implies quasi-separated, DM implies quasi-DM, and representable by algebraic spaces implies DM (author lemma at source lines 681-689, label lemma-trivial-implications). The proof (source lines 691-700) unwinds each implication to a statement about the diagonal of the morphism: properness of the diagonal for the first, unramifiedness and hence local quasi-finiteness for the second, and representability of the diagonal for the third (proof lines 691-699). The translation of each hypothesis into a property of the diagonal is the content. H2.
